premise: Rabbit bounces up to play and Snail hides in his shell; only when Rabbit sits very still does Snail peek out.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop): what bouncing and knocking cannot do, quiet warmth does; turned into a friendship between the fastest and the shyest.
lesson: Gentleness makes room for shy friends.

en-US.title: Snail Comes Out to Play
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.3} [slowly] Slowly, slowly, {snail:enter} Snail crawled across the meadow, enjoying the morning. Then… [excited] {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came bouncing along. Boing, boing, BOING! {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x2} Snail, let's play! {snail:face surprised} Oh! Snail {snail:live hold} pulled in his head and hid inside his shell. Rabbit knocked. {sfx:knock} Knock, knock. Nothing. He {rabbit:hop x3} bounced all around. Nothing. {rabbit:face sad} [sad] Snail doesn't like me, he said. The big yellow {flower:enter} flower popped up beside them and {flower:wobble} nodded. [softly] Try sitting still, she said. {rabbit:face normal} So Rabbit sat very still. {canvas:sunshine 0.7 18s} The sun was warm, and a {butterfly:enter} butterfly drifted by. Rabbit's ears {rabbit:live} went up. He listened… then relaxed and nibbled a clover leaf. Then slowly, slowly, Snail {snail:live resume} peeked out and looked around. {snail:face happy} [whispers] Hello, Rabbit. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hearts} [happily] And they played the slowest game in the forest: who can sit still the longest. Nobody won. {all:face happy} Everybody smiled.

es-ES.title: Caracol sale a jugar
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.3} [slowly] Despacito, despacito, {snail:enter} Caracol cruzaba el prado, disfrutando de la mañana. Y entonces… [excited] {rabbit:enter} Conejo llegó dando botes. ¡Boing, boing, BOING! {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x2} ¡Caracol, vamos a jugar! {snail:face surprised} ¡Oh! Caracol {snail:live hold} metió la cabeza y se escondió en su concha. Conejo llamó. {sfx:knock} Toc, toc. Nada. {rabbit:hop x3} Dio saltos alrededor. Nada. {rabbit:face sad} [sad] Caracol no me quiere, dijo. La gran {flower:enter} flor amarilla asomó a su lado y {flower:wobble} movió los pétalos. [softly] Prueba a quedarte quieto, le dijo. {rabbit:face normal} Así que Conejo se sentó muy quieto. {canvas:sunshine 0.7 18s} El sol calentaba, y pasó volando una {butterfly:enter} mariposa. {rabbit:live} Conejo levantó las orejas. Escuchó… luego se relajó y mordisqueó un trébol. Y despacito, despacito, Caracol {snail:live resume} asomó y miró a su alrededor. {snail:face happy} [whispers] Hola, Conejo. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hearts} [happily] Y jugaron al juego más lento del bosque: a ver quién se queda quieto más rato. Nadie ganó. {all:face happy} Todos sonrieron.

knock.prompt: two light hollow knocks on a small snail shell, soft and cute
